blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Annotator disagreement is increasingly recognized as a meaningful property of subjective tasks, rather than merely noise to be removed. Predicting which items are likely to be contested could help allocate annotation effort and route difficult cases to human review. We propose predicting disagreement from interpretable semantic properties of the text. An LLM answers a set of binary questions covering harmful-content characteristics, disagreement-related cues such as borderline severity and missing context, and language-sensitive cues such as local slurs. A classifier predicts disagreement from these answers, and we analyze which questions contribute most to the predictions. Across four datasets in English, German, and Turkish and three open-weight LLMs, our structured question features outperform direct prompting by 10.5 ROC-AUC points and the strongest text-based baselines by 5.0 points. A compact subset of eight questions performs within 1.5 ROC-AUC points of the full twenty-question set. In leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, models retain roughly 90-95% of their in-domain ROC-AUC. Across models and datasets, questions about derogation, missing context, and decision boundaries serve as the strongest predictors, suggesting that what makes harmful content contested is partly observable in the text.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Annotators often disagree when labeling subjective tasks. A post that one annotator marks as hateful, another may consider merely offensive, and a third may see as acceptable. For a long time, such disagreement was treated as noise, resolved through majority voting or adjudication, and then discarded ( Pavlick and Kwiatkowski, 2019 ) . A growing body of work now argues that disagreement is a meaningful property of subjective tasks, reflecting ambiguity, missing context, and differences in annotators’ backgrounds and beliefs ( Plank, 2022 ; Sap et al., 2022 ; Davani et al., 2022 ) . Harmful content is a clear case: what counts as hateful or offensive depends on who is reading, which cultural and linguistic norms apply, and how much context is available ( Pachinger et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在标注主观任务时,注释者往往持不同意见. 一个书记员认为一个帖子是可憎的,另一个帖子可能认为只是冒犯性的,第三个帖子可能认为是可以接受的. 长久以来,这种分歧被当作噪音,通过多数投票或裁决解决,然后被抛弃(Pavlick和Kwiatkowski,2019年). 现在,越来越多的工作认为,分歧是主观任务的有意义的财产,反映了模糊不清、缺失的背景以及注释者背景和信仰的差异(Plank,2022;Sap等,2022;Davani等,2022)。 有害的内容是一个明显的例子:什么是令人憎恶或冒犯取决于谁在阅读,哪些文化和语言规范适用,以及有多少背景(Pachinger等,2025年)。

blocks.en:
If disagreement is informative, predicting it is useful. A disagreement predictor can indicate where to collect additional annotations, which items to route to human moderators ( Villate-Castillo et al., 2024 ) , and which parts of a dataset need to be audited. Obtaining disagreement labels, however, requires several annotators per item, which is costly and rarely feasible for new languages. A natural shortcut is to use LLMs, which are now widely used as annotators ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Gligorić et al., 2025 ) .
However, they struggle to predict disagreement directly ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , and tend to collapse the diversity of human judgments ( Chochlakis et al., 2025 ) . Specifically for harmful content, LLMs align more with the Western community, even when prompted in the native language ( Bui et al., 2025 ; Masud et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
如果分歧是信息化的,预测是有用的。 分歧预测器可以指出收集附加说明的地点,哪些项目通往人类主持人(Villate-Castillo等人,2024年),数据集哪些部分需要审计. 但是,要获得分歧的标签,每件需要几个注释员,这对新语言来说成本高昂,而且很少可行。 一个自然的捷径是使用LLMS,它们现在被广泛用作注释器(Tan等,2024;Gligoric等,2025.).
然而,他们竭力直接预测分歧(Ni等,2026年),并倾向于瓦解人类判断的多样性(Chochlakis等,2025年)。 具体地说,对于有害的内容,LLMS与西方社区更加一致,即使受到当地语言的刺激(Bui等,2025;Masud等,2024)。

blocks.en: Existing approaches leave two gaps. First, they offer limited insight into why an item is contested. One line of work models disagreement from the annotator side, using their identities, demographics, or beliefs ( Davani et al., 2022 ; Fleisig et al., 2023 ; Sap et al., 2022 ) . This requires annotator-level information that is often unavailable, and demographics alone explain only part of the variation ( Orlikowski et al., 2023 ) . Another line trains classifiers to predict disagreement directly from text ( Fornaciari et al., 2021 ; Villate-Castillo et al., 2024 ) , or aligns LLM uncertainty with human disagreement through fine-tuning ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . These models can be accurate, but their predictions are not tied to explicit properties of the text. Analyses of text-side factors exist ( Sandri et al., 2023 ; Falk and Lapesa, 2025 ) , but they rely on manual annotation or post hoc correlation rather than on a predictive model. Second, the obvious alternative of asking an LLM whether annotators would disagree works poorly. LLMs struggle to capture annotator disagreement ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , and they tend to be overconfident on the low-agreement items that matter most ( Lu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有做法留下了两个空白。 首先,它们对于某一项目为何受到质疑提供了有限的见解。 一种工作模式与注释方意见不一,使用其身份、人口或信仰(Davani等,2022;Fleisig等,2023;Sap等,2022)。 这需要往往无法获得的注释层信息,而人口统计只是解释其中的一部分变化(Orlikovski等,2023年)。 另一行列车的分类器可以直接预测出与文本的分歧(Fornaciari等,2021;Villate-Castillo等,2024;或通过微调将LLM不确定性与人类的分歧联系起来(Lu等,2026). 这些模型可以准确,但其预测并不与文本的明显属性相挂钩. 文本边因素的分析是存在的(Sandri等,2023;Falk和Lapesa,2025),但它们依赖于手动注释或事后关联,而不是预测模型. 第二,询问LLM的明显替代办法是,说明者是否不同意,这样做效果不好。 LLMs为抓住注释者分歧而挣扎(Ni等,2026年),他们往往对关系最重大的低协议项目过于自信(Lu等,2025年).

blocks.en: We propose predicting disagreement from interpretable properties of the text. Rather than asking an LLM for a holistic judgment, we ask a set of targeted binary questions about each item. The questions fall into three groups: questions about derogatory and hateful content (whether the text uses slurs or dehumanizes a group), questions about boundary cues associated with disagreement (whether the severity is borderline or context is missing), and questions about language- and culture-specific cues (whether the text contains a local slur or coded insult). A random forest classifier predicts disagreement from the answers, and we use TreeSHAP to attribute each prediction to individual questions. Unlike token attributions or a direct LLM judgment, our features are interpretable by construction: each is the answer to a named question, so importance can be read at the level of concepts rather than words. We evaluate this across three open-weight LLMs, Gemma 3 27B, Mistral Small 3.2 24B, and Qwen 3.6 27B, and four datasets spanning three languages: the English MHS and HateXplain, the Turkish Hate Speech Dataset, and the German DeTox.
blocks.zh: 我们提议预测对案文可解释性意见的分歧。 我们不是要求一个LLM来进行整体判断,而是就每个项目提出一系列有针对性的二进制问题。 问题分为三组:关于贬损和仇恨内容的问题(文本是使用污名还是非人化),与分歧相关的边界提示问题(严重程度是边界线还是缺少上下文),以及语言和文化特定提示问题(文本中是否包含当地污名还是被编码的侮辱)。 一个随机的森林分类器预测了与答案的分歧,我们使用TreeSHAP将每个预测归为单个问题. 与符号属性或直接的LLM判断不同,我们的特征可以通过构造来解释:每个特征都是一个被命名问题的答案,所以重要性可以在概念层面而不是文字层面来读取. 我们通过三种开放量级的LLMs、Gemma 3 27B、Mistral Small 3.2 24B和Quen 3.6 27B, 以及跨越三种语言的四套数据集(英语:MHS and HateXplain,土耳其仇恨言论数据集和德德语DeTox)来评估这一点。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1): We formulate annotator disagreement prediction as answering interpretable questions about the text, and introduce a set of twenty questions covering harmful content, boundary cues, and language-specific cues. (2): We show across four datasets, three languages, and three LLMs that these features predict disagreement better than direct prompting and text-based baselines, and that eight questions suffice. (3): We analyze which questions drive disagreement predictions and release the questions, prompts, and LLM answers for all datasets and show that question-based disagreement predictors transfer across datasets, retaining most of their in-domain performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: (1) 我们提出注释员的分歧预测,作为对文本的解释性问题的回答,并介绍一组20个问题,涉及有害内容、边界提示和具体语言提示。 (2) 我们通过四个数据集、三种语言和三种LLMs显示,这些特征预测分歧比直接提示和基于文本的基线要好,8个问题就够了。 (3):我们分析哪些问题驱动分歧预测,并发布所有数据集的问题,提示和LLM答案,并显示基于问题的差异预测器跨数据集传输,保留了大部分域内性能.

blocks.en: Our question-based approach outperforms direct prompting by 10.5 ROC-AUC points and the strongest supervised embedding baseline by 5.0 points. Boundary and context questions add a consistent signal on top of content questions, and a subset of eight questions performs within 1.5 points of the full set of twenty, reducing LLM calls by 60%. In leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, without any explicit language or dataset feature, models retain 90–95% of their in-domain ROC-AUC. Questions on derogation and context are the most consistently important across languages and models.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Disagreement in subjective annotation was long treated as noise, but a growing body of work shows it is systematic. Akhtar et al. (2020) found polarized annotator groups in hate speech, Leonardelli et al. (2021) showed that offensive language datasets contain many low-agreement items, and Plank (2022) framed label variation as a property of the data to be modeled. Later work examined why annotators disagree. Sap et al. (2022) linked toxicity ratings to annotator beliefs and identities, Sandri et al. (2023) proposed a taxonomy of disagreement reasons such as ambiguity and missing context, and Pachinger et al. (2025) showed that high-disagreement toxic items reflect subjective perception rather than inconsistency. Disagreement also has a cultural dimension, as shown for English hate speech ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , multilingual irony ( Casola et al., 2024 ) , and multilingual hateful memes ( Bui et al., 2025 ) . These studies identify the sources of disagreement through manual analysis or correlation ( Falk and Lapesa, 2025 ) , but none use these sources to predict disagreement. Our boundary and context questions operationalize these reasons as automatically extracted features.
blocks.zh: 主观注释上的分歧长期以来被视为噪音,但越来越多的工作表明它是系统性的。 Akhtar等(2020年)在仇恨言论中发现极分化的注释者群体,Leonardelli等(2021年)显示攻击性语言数据集包含许多低协议项目,而Plank(2022年)将标签变异设定为要建模的数据属性. 后来的工作研究了为什么注释者有不同意见. 萨普等. (2022年)将毒性评级与注释者的信仰和身份联系起来,Sandri等人(2023年)提出了一个关于模糊和缺少上下文等分歧原因的分类法,而Pachinger等人(2025年)则表明,高度分歧的有毒物品反映了主观认知而不是不一致. 分歧也具有文化层面,例如:英国仇恨言论(Lee等,2024年),多语种讽刺(Casola等,2024年)和多语种可恨的记忆(Bui等,2025年). 这些研究通过人工分析或关联(Falk和Lapesa,2025年)找出了分歧的来源,但都没有利用这些来源来预测分歧. 我们的边界和背景问题使这些理由成为自动提取的特征。

blocks.en: Early models of disagreement took the annotator’s perspective, predicting individual labels with per-annotator heads ( Davani et al., 2022 ) or from demographics ( Fleisig et al., 2023 ) . These need annotator metadata, which explains only part of the variation ( Orlikowski et al., 2023 ) . Text-side approaches instead learn label distributions, from soft-label multi-task learning ( Fleisig et al., 2023 ) to disagreement as an auxiliary moderation task ( Villate-Castillo et al., 2024 ) and LLMs fine-tuned to express human-like uncertainty ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Their predictions, however, are not tied to explicit properties of the text. More recently, LLMs have been tested as direct judges of disagreement, and they fall short: they reproduce majority views ( Chochlakis et al., 2025 ) , are overconfident on low-agreement offensive items ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , and struggle to predict disagreement when asked directly ( Ni et al., 2026 ) . We avoid both limitations. LLMs answer targeted questions they can judge reliably, and an interpretable model learns the mapping to disagreement, without annotator metadata.
blocks.zh: 早期的分歧模型采用了注释者的观点,预言个人的标签带有每个注释者的头(Davani等人,2022年)或来自人口学(Fleisig等人,2023年). 这些需要注释元数据,这只能解释部分变异(Orlikowski等,2023年). 相反地,文本侧式方法学习了标签分布,从软标签多任务学习(Fleisig等,2023年)到作为辅助温和任务的分歧(Villate-Castillo等,2024年)和LLMs微调来表达人性的不确定性(Lu等,2026年). 然而,它们的预测并不与案文的明确性质挂钩。 最近,LLMs被测试为分歧的直接裁判,它们还很短:它们转载多数人的观点(Chochlakis等,2025年),对低协议的冒犯性项目(Lu等,2025年)过于自信,在直接被问及时难以预测分歧(Ni等,2026年). 我们避免两种限制。 LLMS解答了他们可以可靠判断的有针对性问题,一个可解释的模型学习了映射到分歧,而没有注释元数据.

blocks.en: Interpretability for harmful content began with token-level rationales, such as HateXplain ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) , and post-hoc attribution methods, which can be unfaithful ( Slack et al., 2020 ) and highlight words rather than concepts. Concept bottleneck models ( Koh et al., 2020 ) address this by routing predictions through human-readable concepts, an approach that has recently been scaled to LLM-based text classification ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . For harmful content, LLM-scored adjectives have served as concepts for hate and counter-speech detection ( Labadie-Tamayo et al., 2026 ) , checklists of binary questions answered by an LLM have similarly been used to make hate speech classification interpretable ( Girón et al., 2026 ) , and LLM-rated hate attributes recover aggregate hate scores more effectively than direct prompting ( Jradi et al., 2026 ) . All of these target the harmfulness label. We apply concept-based prediction to a different target: annotator agreement, which requires concepts that capture what makes content contested rather than what makes it harmful.
blocks.zh: 有害内容的可解释性开始于象征层面的理由,如HateXplain(Mathew等,2021年),和后荷克归属方法,这些方法可能不忠(Slack等,2020年)并突出词而非概念. 概念瓶颈模型(Koh等,2020年)通过人可读概念的路由预测来解决这一问题,这一方法最近被推广到基于LLM的文本分类(Sun等,2025年). 对于有害内容,LLM分数的形容词作为仇恨和反言论检测的概念(Labadie-Tamayo等,2026年),LLM回答的二进制问题核对表同样被用来解释仇恨言论分类(Girón等,2026年),LLM评分的仇恨属性比直接提示更能有效恢复总的仇恨分数(Jradi等,2026年). 所有这些都以有害标签为目标。 我们把基于概念的预测应用于另一个目标:即注释者协议,它要求概念能够捕捉内容引起争议的事物,而不是使其有害的事物.

blocks.en: Harmful content classifiers transfer poorly. Zero-shot cross-lingual detection misses language-specific expressions ( Nozza, 2021 ) , target-language data remains necessary ( Röttger et al., 2022 ; Ghorbanpour et al., 2025b ) , classifiers are culturally insensitive ( Lee et al., 2023 ) , and LLM moderation shifts with geographic cues ( Masud et al., 2024 ) . Recent work narrows the gap through multilingual retrieval ( Ghorbanpour et al., 2025a ) . Disagreement modeling, by contrast, has been evaluated almost exclusively within a single dataset or language ( Dehghan et al., 2025 ; Leonardelli et al., 2025 ; Zaghouani, 2026 ) , likely because transferring disagreement predictors to unseen datasets and languages is more challenging than label transfer, as what is considered contested can depend on local norms. Because our questions are defined independently of any dataset or language, the same representation applies across languages, allowing direct leave-one-dataset-out evaluation.
blocks.zh: 有害内容分类器传输不良. 0发跨语言检测错失了语言特定表达(Nozza, 2021),目标语言数据仍然需要(Röttger等, 2022;Ghorbanpour等, 2025b),分类器在文化上不敏感(Lee等, 2023),LLM温和变化带有地理学提示(Masud等, 2024). 最近的工作通过多语种检索缩小了差距(Ghorbanpour等人,2025a.) 。 。 。 。 相形之下,分歧模型几乎完全在一个数据集或语言范围内得到评价(Dehghan等,2025;Leonardelli等,2025;Zaghouani,2026),可能是因为将分歧预测器转移到隐形数据集和语言比标签传输更具挑战性,因为被认为有争议的内容可能取决于当地规范. 由于我们的问题是独立于任何数据集或语言定义的,因此同样的表述适用于各种语言,从而可以直接对一个数据集进行评价。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We predict annotator disagreement from structured properties of the text. For each item, an LLM answers a fixed set of binary questions covering harmful content, boundary cues, and language-specific cues, and we extract the model’s confidence in each answer from its token probabilities. The answers, confidences, and pairwise combinations of answers form a feature vector that is shared across datasets. A random forest trained on this vector predicts whether annotators disagree, both within a dataset and on unseen datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们预测,注释者不同意文本的结构属性。 对于每个项目,一个LLM会回答一组固定的二进制问题,包括有害内容、边界提示和语言特定提示,我们从模型的象征概率中提取模型对每个答案的信心。 解答,置信,和对接的解答组合构成一个功能向量,在数据集之间共享. 对这个载体进行培训的随机森林可以预测,无论是在数据集内还是在无形数据集上,注释者是否不同意。

blocks.en:
We use a deliberately minimal, dataset-agnostic target: whether at least two annotators assign different
labels. So defined, it is invariant to the label inventory and depends only on label identity, not meaning, so binary and multi-class schemes, and
intermediate labels, are treated uniformly. Observed disagreement does rise with the number of annotators per item, but across our datasets, disagreement rates do not track annotator counts, indicating that count is not the dominant factor. We also train and evaluate within each dataset rather than comparing raw disagreement magnitudes across them, so differences in annotation protocol do not enter our claims.
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个故意最小的,数据集不可知的目标: 至少两个注释者是否指定不同的
标签。 如此定义,它与标签目录不相干,仅依赖于标签身份,而非意义,所以二进制和多类方案,以及
中间标签,统一处理。 观察到的分歧确实随着每个项目的注释者数量而增加,但是在我们的数据集中,分歧率没有跟踪注释者的计数,表明计数不是主导因素. 我们还在每个数据集内进行训练和评估,而不是比较它们之间原始的分歧程度,因此注释协议的不同并不包含我们的说法。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 4 实验细节

blocks.en: We use four harmful-content datasets that provide labels from multiple annotators per item. MHS (Measuring Hate Speech) ( Kennedy et al., 2020 ; Sachdeva et al., 2022 ) contains English comments from Reddit, Twitter, YouTube, and Gab, annotated by a large pool of crowdworkers with detailed demographic records; we use 29,453 29{,}453 comments, of which 40.4 % 40.4\% have disagreement. HateXplain ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) contains English posts from Twitter and Gab, each labeled by three annotators as hate speech, offensive, or normal; we use 19,192 19{,}192 comments, with a disagreement rate of 48.7 % 48.7\% . The Turkish Hate Speech Dataset ( Toraman et al., 2022 ) contains Turkish tweets across several target domains, such as religion, gender, race, politics, and sports, labeled as hate, offensive, or normal; we use the 60,308 60{,}308 multiply-annotated comments, of which 46.6 % 46.6\% have disagreement. DeTox ( Demus et al., 2022 ) contains German comments from news and social media platforms, annotated by multiple annotators with a binary label; we use 9,689 9{,}689 comments, with a disagreement rate of 21.5 % 21.5\% . Further details are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们使用四个有害内容数据集,每个项目提供多个注释器的标签. 卫生部 (Measuring Hate Speech)(肯尼迪等,2020;Sachdeva等,2022)收录了来自Reddit,Twitter,YouTube,和Gab的英文评论,由一大群人口统计记录详尽的人群工作者注释;我们使用29,453个评论,其中40.4%的40.4%有不同意见. HateXplain(Mathew等,2021年)收录了来自Twitter和Gab的英文帖子, 每个帖子被三个注目者标注为仇恨言论、攻击或平凡; 土耳其仇恨言论数据集(Toraman等人,2022年)载有: 土耳其的推特跨越宗教、性别、种族、政治和体育等多个目标领域, DeTox(Demus等,2022年)收录了来自新闻和社交媒体平台的德文评论,由多位带有二进制标签的注释者作注释;我们使用9,689 9{,}689个评论,分歧率为21.5% 21.5\%. 详情见附录A。

blocks.en: We extract question answers with three open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs of similar size from different families: Gemma 3 27B ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , Mistral Small 3.2 24B ( Mistral AI Team, 2025 ) , and Qwen 3.6 27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Using several families lets us test whether results depend on a specific model. All LLMs are used for inference only, with greedy decoding, and generation is limited to a single answer token so that token probabilities can be read directly. As the disagreement classifier, we use a random forest with balanced class weights to account for the different disagreement rates across datasets. A separate classifier is trained for each LLM, so features from different LLMs are never mixed. Inference settings and classifier hyperparameters are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们用来自不同家庭的3个类似大小的开放式指令调制LLMs取出问题答案:Gemma 3 27B(Gemma Team,2025年),Mistral Small 3.2 24B(Mistral AI Team,2025年)和Quen 3.6 27B(Quen Team,2026年). 利用几个家庭来检验结果是否取决于具体模式。 所有LLMS都只用于推论,有贪婪的解码,而生成仅限于一个回答符号,这样可以直接读取符号概率. 作为分歧的分类者,我们使用一个具有平衡的类分权的随机森林来说明不同数据集的不同分歧率. 每个LLM都训练出一个单独的分类器,因此不同LLMs的特性从未被混合. 推断设置和分类器超参数载于附录B。

blocks.en: Each question is asked in a separate prompt, so the answer to one question cannot influence another. Each prompt is few-shot, and the model answers with yes or no . The content questions are adopted from the checklist of Girón et al. (2026) , which decomposes hate speech into established definitional components. Every prompt has the same structure: a system instruction describing the role of a content analyst, a short definition of the property being asked about, the text to analyze, and an instruction to answer only yes or no . The definitions are shared across datasets and do not refer to any dataset’s annotation guidelines or label set, keeping the representation independent of how each dataset was annotated. Prompts are written in English for all datasets, while the text is kept in its original language, so the LLM handles German and Turkish input with English instructions. The full list of questions and prompt templates is in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 每个问题都是在一个单独的即时提出,因此一个问题的答案不能影响另一个问题. 每个提示都是几发子弹 模型回答是或否 内容问题取自Girón等人的核对表(2026年),其中将仇恨言论分解为既定的定义部分. 每个提示都有相同的结构:一个描述内容分析师角色的系统指令,一个被询问属性的简短定义,一个用于分析的文本,以及一个只回答是或否的指示. 定义在数据集之间共享,并不提及任何数据集的注释准则或标签集,而是将表述独立于每个数据集的注释。 所有数据集的提示用英文写出,而文本则保留在原文中,因此LLM处理有英文指令的德文和土耳其文输入. 完整的问题清单和即时模板载于附录C。

blocks.en: For in-domain experiments, we use 3-fold cross-validation grouped by normalized text, so that no text appears in more than one fold. Within each training fold, we hold out a validation split to tune the decision threshold. For transfer, we use leave-one-dataset-out evaluation: the classifier is trained on three datasets and tested on the fourth, with no explicit dataset or language feature given to the classifier. Our primary metrics are threshold-independent: ROC-AUC and PR-AUC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. We additionally report macro-F1 and MCC, selecting their thresholds on validation data. For transfer, we report relative ROC-AUC, the ratio of transfer to in-domain ROC-AUC on the same dataset.
blocks.zh: 对于域内实验,我们使用由正版文本分组的3倍交叉验证,这样文本就不会以多一叠的形式出现. 在每个训练环节中,我们进行验证分解,以调整决定门槛。 为了转移,我们使用留一数据集评价:分类器在三个数据集上接受培训,并在第四个数据集上测试,没有给分类器赋予明确的数据集或语言特征. 我们的主要衡量标准是阈值独立的:ROC-AUC和PR-AUC,它们对阶级不平衡很敏感. 我们还报告宏观-F1和MCC,选择其验证数据的阈值。 为了传输,我们在同一数据集上报告相对的ROC-AUC,传输与域内ROC-AUC的比例.

blocks.en: We compare the question-based predictor against several baselines, all evaluated on the same instances and folds. Direct prompting is a label-free reference that asks the same LLM (few-shot) whether annotators would disagree and scores the item by its probability of "disagree." As text baselines, we train the same random forest used by our method on multilingual sentence embeddings (LaBSE ( Feng et al., 2022 ) , multilingual E5 base ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and Qwen 3 0.6B embeddings ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ), testing whether a text representation alone predicts disagreement. We fix the classifier to a random forest rather than fine-tuning an LLM, so any difference reflects the input representation rather than classifier capacity, and it supports per-question TreeSHAP attribution. We replaced the random forest model with XGBoost or logistic regression, and the results changed negligibly. We additionally report two privileged, label-based controls: a random forest trained on the gold majority label, which tests whether disagreement is explained by the label itself, and one trained on the gold label together with the LLM’s harmful-content output. These controls are privileged because the gold majority label is not available for a new, unlabeled item, and they appear in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们把基于问题的预测器与几个基线进行比较,所有基线都在同一实例和折叠上得到评价。 直接提示(Direct pointing)是一种无标签的引用,它询问同样的LLM(few-shot),注释者是否会不同意,并根据其"不同意"的概率对项目进行评分. 作为文字基线,我们在多语种句子嵌入(LABSE (Feng等,2022年)),多语种E5基(Wang等,2024年),和Quen 3 0.6B嵌入(Zhang等,2025年)上训练出我们的方法所使用的同一种随机森林,测试单是文本表述是否预测了分歧. 我们把分类器固定在一个随机的森林中,而不是微调一个LLM,所以任何区别都反映输入表示而不是分类能力,它支持每个问题TreeSHAP的归属. 我们用"XGBoost"或"物流回归"取代了随机森林模型,结果微乎其微. 此外,我们还报告两个基于标签的特权控制:一个是金多数标签上的随机森林,测试是否由标签本身来解释分歧,另一个是金标签上的培训,以及LLM的有害内容产出。 这些控制是例外的,因为黄金多数的标签不能用于新的未加标签的物品,它们出现在附录D中。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate how well question-based features predict disagreement and how much each question set contributes (§ 5.1 ). We then analyze which questions drive the predictions (§ 5.2 ) and if predictors transfer to unseen datasets and languages (§ 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价基于问题的特征如何能很好地预测分歧,以及每组问题能贡献多少(第5.1节)。 然后,我们分析哪些问题驱动了预测(§ 5.2),如果预测器转移到看不见的数据集和语言(§ 5.3).

blocks.en: 5.1 Predicting Disagreement
blocks.zh: 5.1 预测分歧

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the performance of the proposed method and compares it with the results from baseline studies. For all three LLMs, question-based features with confidence outperform the label-free baselines on every dataset. Asking the LLM directly whether annotators would disagree is the weakest approach: the same LLMs improve by 10.5 ROC-AUC points on average when asked targeted questions instead. The gains are largest on DeTox ( + 15.2 +15.2 ) and MHS ( + 14.6 +14.6 ), the two datasets with the lowest disagreement rates, and smallest on Turkish ( + 5.5 +5.5 ) and HateXplain ( + 6.6 +6.6 ). This is consistent with prior findings that LLMs struggle to estimate disagreement when asked directly ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Question features also outperform the embedding-based text baselines for all 12 dataset–LLM combinations, by 3.6 3.6 ROC-AUC points on average. The full model performs similarly across LLMs, with differences of at most 2.5 2.5 ROC-AUC points on any dataset, and Qwen is best on three of four datasets. We additionally compare against two privileged controls that take the human gold label as input; our question-based features outperform both on most datasets, the exception being HateXplain (Appendix D ). Across three outer folds, the standard deviations are small, below 0.5 0.5 ROC-AUC points on the larger datasets and higher on HateXplain and DeTox, and in all cases smaller than the gaps between our model and the baselines, so the method ranking is stable (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 表2列出了拟议方法的绩效,并将其与基线研究的结果相比较。 对于所有3个LLM,有自信的以问题为基础的特性超过了每个数据集的无标签基线。 直接问LLM是否持不同意见是最弱的方法:同样的LLMs在被问到有针对性的问题时,平均提高了10.5个ROC-AUC点。 在DeTox(+15.2+15.2)和MHS(+14.6+14.6)这两个差异率最低的数据集上收益最大,在土耳其语(+ 5.5+5.5)和HateXplain(+ 6.6+6.6)上收益最小。 这与先前的调查结果是一致的,即LLMs在直接被询问时难以估计分歧(Ni等人,2026;Lu等人,2026)。 问题特征也平均比所有12个数据集-LLM组合的嵌入式文本基线高出3.6个ROC-AUC点. 完整的模型在LLMs之间也具有类似的功能,在任何数据集上的相差最多为2.5个ROC-AUC点,而Quen在四个数据集中的三个数据集上最好. 我们还比较了将人类金色标签作为输入的两个特权控制;我们基于问题的特性在大多数数据集上都优于两者,例外是HateXplain(附录D)。 横跨出三个外折面,标准偏差很小,在较大数据集上低于0.5 ROC-AUC分数,在HateXplain和DeTox上则更高,在所有情况下都小于我们模型和基线之间的差距,因此方法排名稳定(Appendix E.

blocks.en: Boundary and language/context questions add signal beyond content questions for every LLM and dataset. Combining both groups with content questions improves ROC-AUC by 2.5 2.5 points (Gemma), 7.3 7.3 points (Mistral), and 3.7 3.7 points (Qwen) on average. Boundary questions contribute more than language/context questions, with average gains of 1.8 1.8 , 6.7 6.7 , and 3.1 3.1 points compared to 1.3 1.3 , 4.2 4.2 , and 1.8 1.8 , and a larger gain in 10 of 12 combinations. For Mistral and Qwen, the gains are largest on the non-English datasets: DeTox ( + 16.6 +16.6 and + 6.2 +6.2 ) and Turkish ( + 7.6 +7.6 and + 4.8 +4.8 ), compared to at most 2.7 on the English datasets. For Gemma, gains are more uniform across datasets ( 1.2 1.2 – 3.3 3.3 ). Adding answer confidence further improves ROC-AUC by 1.4 1.4 , 2.4 2.4 , and 2.7 2.7 points, again in all 12 combinations, indicating that how clearly a property is present is informative beyond whether it is present. Adding pairwise answer interactions instead of confidence yields a smaller gain, and adding them on top of confidence does not help further ( 73.5 73.5 vs. 73.6 73.6 average ROC-AUC), so we use confidence only.
blocks.zh: 边界和语言/文本问题为每个LLM和数据集添加超出内容问题的信号. 将两个组和内容问题结合起来,ROC-AUC平均提高了2.5分(Gemma),7.3分(Mistral)和3.7分(Quen). 边界问题对语言/文本问题的贡献大于语言/文本问题,平均收益为1.81.8分,6.7 6.7分,3.1 3.1分,而1.3 1.3分,4.2 4.2分,1.8 1.8分,12个组合中的10个增益较大. 对于Mistral和Quen来说,非英语数据集的收益最大:DeTox(+16.6+16.6和+6.2+6.2)和土耳其语(+7.6+7.6和+4.8+4.8),而英语数据集最多为2.7. 对Gemma来说,各数据集的收益更为一致(1.2 1.2-3.3 3.3)。 添加回答信心会进一步提高ROC-AUC的1.4 1.4,2.4 2.4,和2.7 2.7分,这在所有12个组合中再次表明,一个属性的存在有多明显,除了是否存在之外,还提供了信息. 添加对接的回答互动而不是置信产生更小的收益,在置信之上添加它们无助于进一步(73.5 73.5对73.6 平均ROC-AUC),因此我们只使用置信.

blocks.en: Since each question costs one LLM call per item, we select a compact subset. For each LLM, we run a beam search on the validation split that adds questions one at a time to maximize validation PR-AUC, as detailed in Appendix F . The selected set of eight questions differs by model but recurs around a shared core: the local-slur question m1 is selected for all three LLMs, and derogation and context questions appear repeatedly. On the held-out test set, the eight-question model achieves 71.2 71.2 – 71.9 71.9 ROC-AUC, within 0.9 0.9 to 1.5 1.5 points of the full twenty-question model at 72.5 72.5 – 73.4 73.4 , while reducing the number of LLM calls by 60 % 60\% . Figure 1 shows performance as a function of the number of selected questions. The selected sets draw on all three question groups, which confirms that boundary and language/context questions are not redundant with content questions.
blocks.zh: 由于每个问题每个项目需要一次LLM呼叫,我们选择一个紧凑的子集. 对于每个LLM,我们对验证拆分进行光束搜索,每次增加一个问题,以最大限度地验证PR-AUC,详见附录F. 所选取的8个问题集因模型不同而异,但围绕一个共享的核心来重复:所有3个LLMs都选择了本地-slur问题m1,而减损和上下文问题反复出现. 在被搁置的测试组上,"八问"模型实现71.2 71.2 – 71.9 71.9 ROC-AUC,在72.5 72.5 72.5 – 73.4 73.4 → 73.4 → 20问"完全"模型的0.9到1.5 1.5分以内,同时将LLM调用次数减少60% 60\%. 图1显示业绩是选定问题数量的一个函数。 所选的套集借鉴了所有三个问题组,这证实了边界和语言/文本问题与内容问题并不相重复.

blocks.zh: 图1:挂出测试PR-AUC作为选定题数的函数.

blocks.en: 5.2 What Signals Disagreement
blocks.zh: 5.2 什么是信号分歧

blocks.en: Figure 2: Per-question TreeSHAP importance, as each question’s share of the total attribution within a dataset, for the three LLMs. Questions are grouped into content (q), boundary (d), and language/context (m).
blocks.zh: 图2:每个问题在数据集内的总归属中所占的份额,对三个有限责任公司的重要性。 问题分为内容(q)、分界线(d)和语言/文字(m)。

blocks.en: We use TreeSHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) to attribute each prediction to the questions, summing a question’s answer and confidence contributions. Two questions recur across datasets and LLMs: the derogation question q2 is among the five most important in all twelve dataset–LLM combinations, and the context-or-intent question q9 in ten. The dehumanization question q4 and the local-slur question m1 follow, each in the top five of eight combinations. Disagreement is signaled not by the presence of harmful content alone, but by whether the text is derogatory, together with cues that its interpretation is uncertain. We illustrate these predictions on individual posts in Appendix G , showing, for three HateXplain items, the questions that most strongly raise or lower the predicted disagreement.
blocks.zh: 我们用TreeSHAP(Lundberg and Lee, 2017)将每个预测归结为问题, 两个问题在数据集和LLMs之间反复出现:减损问题q2在所有12个数据集-LLM组合中属于5个最重要的问题,而上下文问题q9则属于10个问题。 非人性化问题q4和地-slur问题m1接踵而来,每个问题在8个组合的前5个. 产生分歧的不是仅仅存在有害内容,而是案文是否具有贬义性,同时暗示其解释不确定。 我们对附录G中的个别员额作了这些预测,就三个HateXplain项目而言,显示了最强烈地提出或降低预期分歧的问题。

blocks.en: Which questions matter beyond this core depends strongly on the dataset, as Figure 2 shows. On MHS, content questions dominate, led by derogation (q2, 21.0%), slurs (q3, 12.7%), the local slur (m1, 11.2%), and dehumanization (q4, 11.0%). On DeTox, derogation (q2, 20.6%), dehumanization (q4, 11.7%), and scapegoating (q5, 10.8%) rank highest. Turkish is the clear exception: the slang-and-coded-language question d4 (12.6%), borderline severity (d5, 10.2%), context (q9, 10.0%), and the abuse-versus-harm boundary (d2, 9.3%) are its most important questions, each above every content question except derogation (q2, 9.4%). HateXplain is the flattest, with no question above 8.9% and content, boundary, and language cues all contributing, consistent with its lower overall predictability. The prominence of d4 and d5 on Turkish supports the view that disagreement in non-English data depends more on language-specific and interpretive cues than in the English datasets.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,哪些问题超出这个核心,在很大程度上取决于数据集。 在MHS方面,内容问题占据了主导地位,主要是减损(q2,21.0%)、污名(q3,12.7%)、当地污名(m1,11.2%)和去人化(q4,11.0%)。 在DeTox,减损(q2,20.6%)、非人性化(q4,11.7%)和替罪羊(q5,10.8%)排名最高。 土耳其语是明显的例外:语法和编码语言问题d4(12.6%)、分界线严重性(d5、10.2%)、上下文(q9、10.0%)和虐待与伤害边界(d2、9.3%)是其最重要的问题,每个问题都高于除减损以外的每个内容问题(q2、9.4%)。 HateXplain是最平坦的,没有问题超过8.9%,内容、边界和语言提示都有所贡献,符合其较低的总体可预测性。 在土耳其语上d4和d5的突出地位支持以下观点,即非英语数据的分歧更多地取决于语言的特异性和解释性提示,而不是英语数据集.

blocks.en: Content questions are ten of the twenty, yet in Turkish, the five boundary questions carry more of the attribution than all ten content questions, and on the other datasets, the boundary and language/context groups together take a share comparable to their count. On a per-question basis, they are therefore at least as influential as content questions, which matches the predictive gains from adding them in § 5.1 . The prominence of d4 and m1 in Turkish supports the view that disagreement in non-English data depends more on language-specific and interpretive cues than in the English datasets.
blocks.zh: 内容问题为20个中的10个,然而在土耳其语中,5个边界问题比所有10个内容问题更具有归属性,而在其他数据集中,边界和语言/文字组合在一起,其份额可以与其计算相当。 因此,从每个问题来看,它们至少与内容问题一样具有影响力,这与在第5.1节中增加它们所产生的预测收益相吻合。 d4和m1在土耳其语中的突出地位支持以下观点:非英语数据的分歧更多地取决于语言的特异性和解释性提示,而不是英语数据集.

blocks.en: 5.3 Transfer Across Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.3 跨数据集传输

blocks.en: Table 3: Leave-one-dataset-out transfer. In-domain models are trained and evaluated on the held-out dataset with cross-validation; transfer models are trained on the other three datasets without any explicit language or dataset features. Rel. is the ratio of transfer to in-domain performance (%). All values in %.
blocks.zh: 表3:一档数据调出。 域内模型通过交叉验证在被搁置的数据集上得到培训和评价;传输模型在没有明确语言或数据集特性的情况下在其他三个数据集上得到培训。 Rel.是转移与域内性能的比例(%). 所有数值以%为单位。

blocks.en: Models trained on three datasets and applied to a fourth retain 89.5–95.2% of in-domain ROC-AUC, as shown in Table 3 , even though the held-out dataset differs in language, source platform, annotation guidelines, label set, and disagreement rate, and no explicit language or dataset feature is available to the model. Transfer is strongest for Turkish, at 93.3–95.2%, and HateXplain, at 93.2–94.2%, and lowest for MHS, where it falls to 89.5% for Mistral. The pattern holds for all three LLMs. Transfer models also outperform direct prompting on the same unseen data by a wide margin, for example, 78.3 against 67.5 ROC-AUC on DeTox and 70.2 against 59.9 on MHS for Qwen, so a predictor transferred from other languages is preferable to asking the LLM directly about the target data.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,经过三个数据集培训并应用于第四个数据集的模型保留了89.5-95.2%的域内ROC-AUC,尽管所搁置的数据集在语言、源平台、注释准则、标签集和分歧率方面各不相同,而且该模型没有明确的语言或数据集特征。 土耳其的转移率最高,为93.3-95.2%;HateXplain为93.2-94.2%,而MHS为最低,Mistral为89.5%。 所有3个法学硕士课程的模式保持不变。 传输模型也以相差较大的速度直接在相同的未见数据上激发效果,例如,在DeTox上为78.3对67.5 ROC-AUC,在Quen上为70.2对59.9对MHS,因此从其他语言传输的预测器比直接询问LLM的目标数据要好.

blocks.en: The cost of transfer is higher for the threshold-dependent metrics. PR-AUC retains 92.1–94.0% on HateXplain and Turkish, the two datasets with disagreement rates close to one half, but only 76.7–88.1% on DeTox and MHS, where disagreement is rarer. MCC falls further, for instance, from 35.9 to 22.3 on Turkish and from 44.7 to 38.2 on DeTox for Qwen. Transferred models, therefore, rank contested items reliably, while their scores are shifted with respect to the target distribution, which matters when a fixed threshold is required.
blocks.zh: 取决于阈值的衡量尺度的转移成本较高。 PR-AUC在HateXplain和土耳其保留了92.1-94.0%,这两个数据集的分歧率接近一半,但在DeTox和MHS上只有76.7-88.1%,分歧比较少见. 例如,MCC进一步下降,土耳其语从35.9降至22.3,而Quen语从44.7降至38.2。 因此,转移模型对有争议的项目进行可靠的排序,而其分数则根据目标分布而改变,这在需要固定阈值时很重要。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We studied whether annotator disagreement in harmful content can be predicted from interpretable properties of the text. An LLM answers a fixed set of binary questions about content, boundary cues, and language-specific cues, and a random forest predicts disagreement from the answers. Across four datasets in English, German, and Turkish and three open-weight LLMs, this outperforms asking the same LLMs directly whether annotators would disagree, as well as a supervised text baseline, and a compact set of eight questions retains most of the predictive signal. Which questions matter differ sharply across datasets: content questions dominate on MHS, while boundary questions carry most of the signal on Turkish. Predictors also transfer to unseen datasets and languages, retaining 89.5–95.2% of in-domain ROC-AUC without any explicit language or dataset feature. Disagreement in harmful content is thus partly predictable from explicit, interpretable properties of the text, and these properties are shared enough across datasets to support transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了能否从文本的可解释性来预测注释者对有害内容的分歧。 LLM解答了一组关于内容,边界提示,以及语言特定提示的固定二进制问题,随机森林预言与答案的分歧. 在英文、德文和土耳其文四个数据集和三个开放重量级的LLMs中,这种效果超过直接询问同一LLMs的注释者是否不同意,以及监督文本基线,8个问题的紧凑组合保留了大多数预测信号。 不同数据集中的问题大相径庭:内容问题在MHS上占主导地位,而边界问题则在土耳其语上携带了大部分信号. 预测器还转移到看不见的数据集和语言,保留了89.5%-95.2%的域内ROC-AUC,没有任何明确的语言或数据集特征. 因此,对有害内容的分歧从文本的明确、可解释的属性来看是部分可以预测的,而且这些属性在数据集之间已经足够共享以支持传输。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
We acknowledge that this study has some limitations.
First, our study covers three languages, four datasets, and three open-weight LLMs of comparable size, which is broader than prior work on disagreement prediction, and extending it to further languages, subjective tasks, and model scales is straightforward given the dataset-independent design of the questions.
blocks.zh:
我们认识到,这项研究有一些局限性。
首先,我们的研究涵盖三种语言,四种数据集,三种可比较大小的开放量级LLMS,它比以往关于分歧预测的工作范围更广,并且由于问题的数据集独立设计,将它扩展到更多的语言,主观任务和模型尺度是直截了当的.

blocks.en: Second, we predict whether annotators disagree rather than how strongly, which is the only target that is comparable across datasets that differ in the number of annotators per item and in whether an intermediate category is available; finer-grained targets, such as soft labels, are available for some datasets and offer a promising extension.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们预测的是,注释者是否不同意,而不是强烈程度,这是所有数据集之间唯一一个可比的目标,因为每个项目和中间类别的数目不同;一些数据集可以使用更细微的指标,如软标签,并提供一个有希望的扩展。

blocks.en: Third, feature attribution identifies the properties the predictor relies on rather than the reasons annotators disagreed; we therefore report group-level attribution alongside individual questions and read individual ranks with corresponding care. Fourth, we deliberately model disagreement from the text alone, without annotator identities or demographics, which makes the approach applicable to datasets that do not release annotator information; combining text-side and annotator-side signals is complementary and left to future work.
blocks.zh: 第三,特征归属确定预测者所依赖的属性,而不是注释者不同意的原因;因此,我们报告集体归属与个别问题并列,并以相应的谨慎阅读个人排名。 第四,我们有意将与文本的分歧单独模拟,没有注释员身份或人口统计,这使得方法适用于不发布注释员信息的数据集;将文本侧和注释员侧信号结合起来是互补的,并留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Finally, our design is structural: because predictions are made from a fixed set of named questions, the feature space is human-readable by design, and a prediction can be traced to the questions it relies on. We quantify this reliance with treeSHAP, but we do not claim that these attributions are mechanistically faithful, nor do we use attention-based or other model-internal explanation methods; identifying the questions a predictor uses is not the same as identifying why annotators disagreed.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的设计是结构性的:因为预测是由一组固定的命名问题作出的,所以地物空间通过设计可以被人类读取,一个预测可以追溯到它所依赖的问题. 我们用树质的SHAP来量化这种依赖,但我们并不声称这些属性在机械上是忠实的,我们也不使用基于注意力或其他模型的内部解释方法;确定一个预测器使用的问题与确定为什么注释者不同意并不相同.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our work predicts where annotators are likely to disagree on harmful content, and we see two main considerations. First, disagreement scores are intended to route contested items to human review and to guide additional annotation, not to automate moderation decisions or to discard contested items. Down-weighting items that annotators find divisive could suppress minority perspectives, which runs counter to the perspectivist motivation of this work; the scores should support human judgment, not replace it. Second, our features are produced by LLMs, which carry known cultural and demographic biases in harmful-content judgments, so predicted disagreement reflects the models’ sensitivities as much as the annotators’. We therefore report results across three model families and four datasets rather than relying on a single model.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作预测,在哪些地方,注释者可能对有害内容有不同意见,我们看到两个主要考虑。 首先,分歧分数是为了将有争议的项目交由人审查,并指导补充说明,而不是使温和决定自动化或丢弃有争议的项目。 批判者认为有分歧的减重项目可以压制少数群体的观点,这与这项工作的投机动机背道而驰;分数应该支持人的判断,而不是取而代之. 第二,我们的特点是由LLMS产生的。 LLMs在有害内容判断中带有已知的文化和人口偏见,因此预测的分歧与注释者一样反映了模型的敏感性。 因此,我们报告三个示范家庭和四个数据集的结果,而不是依赖一个单一的模型。

blocks.en: All datasets were used under their original licenses and terms, for their intended research purpose, and we collected no new annotations and processed no personally identifying information beyond what the datasets already contain. The harmful examples in these datasets are offensive by nature, and we handled them only for research on annotation disagreement.
blocks.zh: 所有数据集均按其原有的许可证和条件用于预定的研究目的,我们没有收集新的说明,也没有处理除数据集已包含的内容之外的个人识别信息。 这些数据集中的有害例子自然是令人反感的,我们只为研究注释分歧而处理.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集细节

blocks.en: We use four harmful-content datasets that provide multiple annotations per item, which allows disagreement to be measured. Table 4 reports their statistics. An item is counted as a disagreement when its annotators are not unanimous.
blocks.zh: 我们使用四个有害内容数据集,每个项目提供多处说明,可以测量分歧. 表4报告了它们的统计数字。 当某一项的注释者意见不一致时,则算作分歧。

blocks.en: MHS (Measuring Hate Speech; Kennedy et al., 2020 ; Sachdeva et al., 2022 ) contains English comments from YouTube, Reddit, and Twitter, annotated by US-based crowdworkers. Each annotation gives one of three responses: no hate speech, unclear, or hate speech. We use these responses directly, keeping the intermediate “unclear” class distinct. 1 1 1 Note that “unclear” denotes annotator uncertainty and is not equivalent to the “offensive” class in HateXplain and Turkish. HateXplain ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) contains English posts from Twitter and Gab, each labeled by three annotators as hate, offensive, or normal, following the hate/offensive distinction of Davidson et al. (2017) .
blocks.zh: MHS(Measing Hate Speech; Kennedy等, 2020;Sachdeva等, 2022)包含来自YouTube, Reddit和Twitter的英文评论, 每一份注释都给出了三个答复之一:没有仇恨言论、不明确或仇恨言论。 我们直接使用这些对策,使中间“不明确”类别保持区别。 1个 1 注意“不明确”表示注解者不确定,不等于HateXplain和土耳其语的“犯罪”类别。 HateXplain(Mathew等,2021年)收录了来自Twitter和Gab的英文帖子,每个帖子都被三个注释者标注为"仇恨","冒犯"或"平凡",这是在Davidson等(2017年)的仇恨/愤怒区分之后.

blocks.en: Turkish ( Toraman et al., 2022 ) contains Turkish tweets spanning five domains (religion, gender, race, politics, and sports), each labeled by five annotators as hate, offensive, or normal. The available annotations provide per-class label counts but not annotator identifiers, so annotator-level statistics are not reported for this dataset. DeTox ( Demus et al., 2022 ) contains German comments from social media. It provides a binary harmful/non-harmful label, so its disagreement label reflects agreement over a single binary judgment rather than a three-way choice.
blocks.zh: 土耳其语(Toraman等人,2022年)中包含: 土耳其的推特跨越五个领域(宗教、性别、种族、政治和体育), 可用说明提供了每类标签计数,但不提供注释符标识符,因此本数据集不报告注释符级统计. DeTox (Demus等,2022年)收录了来自社交媒体的德文评论. 它提供了一个二进制有害/无害的标签,因此它的分歧标签反映了对单一二进制判断的一致而不是三取选择.

blocks.en: The disagreement classifier is a random forest with balanced class weights, applied to the question answers and their confidences. It uses 120 trees, a minimum of 8 samples per leaf, a maximum of 0.75 of the training samples per tree, and a fixed seed. A separate classifier is trained for each LLM, so features from different LLMs are never mixed. In-domain results use three outer folds, grouped by normalized text so that no text appears in more than one fold, with an inner validation split used to tune the decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 分歧分级者是一个随机的森林,具有平衡的阶级权重,应用于提问答案和他们的自信. 它使用120棵树,每棵树叶至少取出8个样品,每棵树最多取出0.75个训练样品,并有固定种子. 每个LLM都训练出一个单独的分类器,因此不同LLMs的特性从未被混合. 域内结果使用3个外折叠,由正版文本组合而成,使文本不以一折多出,内部验证分出来来调和决定阈值.

In-domain results use 3-fold cross-validation, stratified by disagreement label and grouped by item so that no item appears in both training and test folds; for the pooled and subset-selection experiments, the group key is the original item identifier shared across the three LLMs. Baselines and question models are evaluated on identical folds.
The experiments were carried out on machines with NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti GPUs. During evaluation, models were used in inference mode without any parameter updates.

blocks.en: Appendix D Label-Based Control Baselines
blocks.zh: 附录D 基于标签的控制基线

blocks.en: To test whether disagreement is explained by the harmful-content label itself, we compare our question-based predictor against two controls that are given the human gold label as input: a random forest trained on the gold majority label, and one trained on the gold label together with the LLM’s harmful-content output. Both are privileged : the gold majority label is not available for a new, unlabeled text, so these are upper-reference baselines rather than deployable systems. They are trained on the combined data across all datasets, so we report them at that scope in the Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 为了检验分歧是否由有害内容标签本身来解释,我们比较了我们基于问题的预测器与作为输入而给予人类黄金标签的两个控制器:一个是金多数标签上的随机森林,另一个是金标签上的随机森林,以及LLM的有害内容输出。 两者都享有特权:黄金多数的标签不能用于一个新的无标签的文本,因此这些是上调基准而不是可部署系统. 他们接受了关于所有数据集综合数据的培训,因此我们在表7中报告了这方面的数据。

blocks.en: Table 7: Combined-trained comparison against label-based controls (%). The gold majority label is a privileged input not available at inference time. ROC and PR are ROC-AUC and PR-AUC; F1 m is macro-F1. Best per block in bold .
blocks.zh: 表7:与基于标签的控制进行综合培训比较(%)。 黄金多数的标签是一种特权输入,在推论时不可用. ROC和PR为ROC-AUC和PR-AUC;F1米为宏-F1. 每个街区最好用粗体表示。

blocks.en: The question-based predictor outperforms the gold-label-only control by 8.8–9.6 ROC-AUC points for all three LLMs, indicating that disagreement is not merely a function of the majority label. It also outperforms the stronger gold-plus-output control on the combined data, despite that baseline’s access to the gold label. The one exception is HateXplain, where the label-based control is higher; the near-even disagreement rate makes the aggregated label an especially strong signal.
blocks.zh: 以问题为基础的预测器将所有三个LLMs的ROC-AUC分数都比只使用金标签的控制高8.8-9.6分,这表明分歧不仅仅是多数标签的一种功能. 其业绩也超过了对综合数据的更强有力的黄金加产出控制,尽管这一基线可以进入黄金标签。 其中一个例外是HateXplain,其中以标签为基础的控制较高;近乎均匀的分歧率使得汇总标签成为一个特别强的信号.

Variability is small on the larger datasets, with ROC-AUC standard deviations below 0.5 points on MHS and Turkish for all three LLMs, and somewhat higher on HateXplain and DeTox, which have fewer test instances per fold. In all cases, the standard deviations are well below the gaps between our models and the baselines in the main table, so the ranking of methods is stable across folds. blocks.en: Appendix F Compact Question Subset Selection
blocks.zh: 附录 F 紧凑问题子集选择

blocks.en: Because each question requires one LLM call per item, a smaller question set lowers inference cost. For each LLM, we select a compact subset with a validation-based beam search, using the same confidence-only features as the full model so that selection and the reported predictor are consistent.
blocks.zh: 因为每个问题都需要每个项目一个LLM调用,所以一个更小的问题设置了较低的推论成本. 对于每个LLM,我们选择一个紧凑的子集,并使用基于验证的光束搜索,使用与完整模型相同的只信任特性,以便选择和报告的预测器保持一致.

blocks.en: The search considers all twenty questions. The selection objective is validation PR-AUC, with ties broken by validation ROC-AUC, then by fewer questions, then by question ID.
blocks.zh: 搜索考虑了所有20个问题。 选择的目标是验证PR-AUC,通过验证断开关系ROC-AUC,然后通过问题减少,再通过问题ID.

blocks.en:
The beam search keeps a beam of the b = 8 b=8 best partial subsets at each size:
(1): Train a random forest on every single question and score it on the validation split.
(2): Retain the b b best single questions.
(3): Expand each retained subset by adding one question not already included.
(4): Score each expanded subset on validation and retain the b b best.
(5): Repeat until size eight.
(6): Select the subset of size at most eight with the highest validation PR-AUC, and report it on the held-out test split.
blocks.zh:
光束搜索保留了 b = 8 b = 8 个最佳部分子集,每个大小:
(1)在每一个问题上训练一棵随机的森林,并在验证分出时给它打分.
(2): 保留 b b 最好的单一问题。
(3): 通过添加一个尚未包含的问题来扩展每个保留子集 。
(4): 在验证时给每个扩展子集打分,并保留最佳b.
(5): 复说至八相.
(6): 选择大小的子集, 最多8个, 并有最高的验证 PR- AUC, 并在被搁置的测试分拆时报告 。

blocks.en: Beam search is used because exhaustively evaluating all subsets of size up to eight is computationally prohibitive. The selected sets differ by model: q2, q7, q8, q9, d5, m1, m2, m3 for Gemma, q1, q2, q3, d2, m1, m2, m3, m4 for Mistral, and q1, q3, q4, q5, q9, d3, m1, m2 for Qwen, with the local-slur question m1 selected for all three.
